replication.target_description: 2014 paper has sine and Fitts groups at two amplitudes, no Impulse group; requested within-Impulse EPV comparison is absent.

n.quote: The groups differed in terms of movement amplitude

reported_success.quote: These results replicate and extend the Boyle, Kennedy, and Shea (2012) and Boyle, Panzer, Wang, Kennedy, and Shea (2013) ﬁndings.

notes: Original analytic n left null: printed Methods N=27 conflicts with ANOVA denominator df=30; no n inferred from df. Replication uses four groups (sine/Fitts × amplitude), with no Impulse group. Authors’ success statement is a paper-level verdict, not a separate verdict for each ANOVA. Original follow-up is narrative only; no numerical effect/test statistic or p printed. Replication has no matching Impulse condition; all target values null.
